enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Fast
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: 2x faster than basic enemies. Worth 2 coins as base value

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Tank
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: 50% speed and x5 health of basic enemies. Worth 4 coins as base value

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Ranged
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: Shoots projectiles from range. Worth 2 coins as base value

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Boss
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: 30% speed and x20 health of basic enemies. Worth 5 coins as base value

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Vampire
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: x2 health of basic enemies. Deals 2% of tower max health per second and disables all tower regen effects. Worth 4 coins as base value

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Ray
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: Same health as basic enemies. Charges up for 30 seconds to fire a ray that deals x2 damage of basic enemy damage. Worth 4 coins as base value

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Scatter
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: x2 health of basic enemies. Splits in half 4 times. Each time a split happens, the health is cut in half. Worth 4 coins as base value

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Protector
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: 20x Basic Enemy Health. Empowers enemies and increases Health within Range.

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Ultimate-disabling enemy
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: 20x Basic Enemy Health. On Tower Impact: Disables 1 random Ultimate Weapon (Restores On Kill).

enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.name: Returning-projectile enemy
enemyDescriptionsFromGameBrain.description: 20x Basic Enemy Health. Fires a returning Projectile at the Tower (Damage doubles per subsequent hit).

rules: Support Saboteurs, Commanders, and Overcharges even if older pasted reports do not include them.
Do not mix enemy subtype totals with kill source rows.
Treat Killed By as the final death cause label from the pasted report, not the full cause analysis by itself.
